sources.quote:
### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI announced prompt caching was available in May 2025, but this passage gives no model-specific cache prices or exact launch day.

sources.quote: Cached tokens are billed at the **cached prompt token price**, which is substantially lower than the regular prompt token price. The exact rates vary by model — check the [Pricing](/developers/pricing) page for current prices.
sources.supports: xAI confirms cached prompt billing is distinct and model-specific; the current documentation does not establish the Grok 3 Mini Fast rate in June 2025.

notes: The models.dev commit describes a schema rename and removal of zero-valued fields, while the xAI release notes say prompt caching became available in May 2025. The provider material available here does not establish whether Grok 3 Mini Fast previously had no cache charge or whether the listed $0.15/$4 rates were newly introduced; the Internet Archive CDX request for xAI pricing returned HTTP 503, so classification and timing remain unclear.
